title: The Year Yoco's Founders Waited to Learn Whether They Could Start
conflicts: Launch month: October 2015 (Bizcommunity launch announcement, Stuff SA 2022) vs November 2015 (SME South Africa 2016) vs 'late/end of 2015' (Wazen 2018, Maphai 2022); story says late 2015 and gives both months. Founding year: 2013 (Media Update 2015, Daily Maverick, CIO, Fast Company SA) vs 2014 (Wikipedia); story uses early 2013. Beta: 'over 500 merchants' (Bizcommunity, Stuff) vs '20 pilot to 550 paying merchants' over ten months (SME SA); story says more than 500. Card-acceptance gap: Maphai (2016) 27 million cardholders and 6% of sellers vs Wazen (2018) 75% of adults and 7% of businesses; story uses Maphai's, attributed.
notes: Episode is the slate's founding decision, focused on the year (2013) spent winning a sponsor bank (Mercantile Bank, payment-facilitator licence) before building; anchored on Maphai's quotations in UCT News (2016) and Daily Maverick (2022). The countertop quotation is from a Fin24 interview reproduced by SME South Africa (original page gone). Founder field names all four co-founders. Funding 'venture' (angel round after the licence, VC from 2017). entrepreneurhubsa.co.za profile not used (unsourced). Quote stance: complicates.
